member.name: T:OpenIGI.UI.Kit.IgiTypography
member.summary: The design's four faces, loaded once and shared by every surface that sets text: the menus, the HUD, the tactical computer, the loading card, the developer console and the launcher.

remarks.para: Barlow for prose and captions; Barlow Condensed SemiBold for the uppercase tracked labels on every tab, button and value; Barlow Condensed Bold for titles, from a 26-unit logo up to a 168-unit mission name; JetBrains Mono for eyebrows, key caps and numbers. All four are under the SIL Open Font License and ship in Assets/fonts.

The condensed faces are distance fields because they are drawn across the widest range of sizes — a coverage atlas minified from 64 to 14 pixels shimmers — while body and mono text stay coverage atlases drawn close to the size they were rasterised at, which is what keeps small text crisp.

How a request becomes a is the caller's: the game uploads an atlas to its device, the launcher keeps the TrueType bytes for its vector renderer. Either way the metrics come from the same atlas build, so a line breaks in the same place in both.

member.name: T:OpenIGI.UI.Kit.TitleReveal
member.summary: The design's title change: the old title wipes out upwards, the new one wipes in from below, resolving out of a blur while its letterspacing tightens, with the caption and description following it in and a light sweep crossing the screen.

remarks.para: Three phases, exactly as the mock-up times them. Out (230 ms): the title fades, rises 40 units, blurs and is wiped away from the left; the caption and description slide 16 units left and fade; the background scales up to 108%. Pre (one frame): the new title is put in place below, wiped shut from the right, tracked out to 0.12 em. In (900 ms): every property eases home on with its own duration, the caption 120 ms behind the title and the description 260 ms; the background settles from 110% over 1.2 s; the sweep crosses in 800 ms.
It holds values, not drawing: a campaign page, a loading card or the launcher's hero reads , and the rest and draws with them, so one timing serves all three.

member.name: T:OpenIGI.UI.Kit.Widgets.OptionCycler
member.summary: One cell of an option strip: a monospaced caption, the value large in the condensed face, a row of pips marking where the value sits in the list, and an up / down pair to step through it.

remarks.para: The campaign's Difficulty, Time and Weather. A cell is a whole choice at a glance — the pips say how many options there are and which one this is, so a player never has to cycle through to find out.
Up and down step the value while the cell holds focus (they are the arrows drawn on it); left and right are left to move between cells, so a pad walks the strip the way it reads.

member.name: T:OpenIGI.UI.Kit.Widgets.PrimaryAction
member.summary: The screen's one primary action — PLAY, RESUME, UPDATE: a big amber block with a corner cut off, the verb large over a small monospaced line, and an arrow in a box at the far end.

remarks.para: While is set the block becomes a progress bar: the amber drops to a translucent wash, a solid fill grows across it, and the verb is replaced by the percentage — the launcher's downloading state, and any long action the game wants to show in place.
Focus and hover lighten the amber, which is the design's only hover state for it; a disabled action greys out entirely, because a dimmed amber still reads as pressable.

member.name: T:OpenIGI.UI.Kit.Widgets.ReorderList
member.summary: A vertical list the player puts in order by dragging, or with the keyboard and pad through a .

remarks.para: The carried item follows the pointer and the others slide aside to show where it will land, eased over rather than jumping, so the eye can follow which row went where. The order changes live as the item crosses its neighbours' middles; is raised once, when it is dropped somewhere other than where it started. Abandoning the drag (Back) puts it back.
The list owns the order it shows from the moment of the drop: the owner hears , records the new order, and finds this list already showing it, so nothing has to be rebuilt.
